positive_snippets:
I had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Aarkay Place. The hotel offers a perfect combination of comfort, cleanliness, and convenience — especially for travelers visiting South Delhi.

The rooms were neat, well-maintained, and equipped with all essential amenities. The staff was polite, responsive, and always ready to help, which made the experience even smoother. Check-in and check-out were hassle-free.

The location is another big advantage — well connected to key areas, markets, and metro stations, making travel around Noida quite easy.

Overall, it’s a reliable and comfortable option for business trips as well as short family stays. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for a value-for-money stay in Noid.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The rooms were spotless, well-designed, and very comfortable. The staff was extremely courteous and always ready to help. Food quality was excellent, and the location made it easy to travel around. Truly value for money—would love to stay here again.

Amazing view from the hotel balcony and gallery. All rooms are properly ventilated with balcony and gallery/corridor with awesome view. I had booked the hotel along with its banquet, lawn and pool area for my haldi, mehendi, sangeet and wedding. Highly satisfied with what they delivered.
negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at Hotel Aarkay Palace and overall, it was a pleasant experience.

I really like the design of the hotel, as every room comes with a balcony, which adds a lot of charm to the stay. The location is excellent, being nearest to Sector 94 and Botanical Garden metro station, making it very convenient.

The breakfast has improved a lot compared to my previous visit in July. During my September stay, I found the breakfast spread much better with more variety. The dinner was also very good – the taste stood out, and I would give full 5 stars to the kitchen staff for the quality and flavor of the food.

Room service is fine – not very good, but not bad either. There is definitely some scope for improvement in service quality. I also feel that the rooms could benefit from a deep cleaning, and the appliances should be repaired and serviced on time to maintain comfort standards.

That being said, I would still recommend Hotel Aarkay Palace for its:

Good location (nearest to Sector 94, Botanical Garden station)

Spacious rooms with balconies

Good breakfast and excellent dinner quality

Friendly kitchen staff delivering tasty food

With a little more attention to housekeeping and service improvements, this hotel can truly become an outstanding place to stay.

I had a very disappointing stay at this hotel. The room was in a terrible condition. There was a bad smell the moment I entered. The bed was extremely dirty, and the bedsheets did not seem clean at all. The TV was not working, and nothing in the room was functioning properly.

Spending even one night here was very difficult. The washroom and bathroom were also not clean, and overall hygiene was very poor. I am highly dissatisfied with the stay and would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
